title: What do you recommend?
setting: A different casual restaurant, early evening. Maya and Chris are still looking at the menu. Their server, Andre, stops by.

lines.speaker: andre
lines.text: Hey, you two good, or you still looking?
lines.spoken: Hey, you two good, or you still looking?

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Still looking, a little. What do you recommend? We're not from here.
lines.spoken: Still looking, a little. What d'you recommend? We're not from here.

lines.speaker: andre
lines.text: It depends. What are you in the mood for? Something heavy, or lighter, or...
lines.spoken: It depends. What're you in the mood for? Something heavy, or lighter, or...

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I can do heavy. I skipped lunch.
lines.spoken: I can do heavy. I skipped lunch.

lines.speaker: andre
lines.text: Then I'd go with the roast chicken. I'm not just saying that. It's actually the thing people come back for.
lines.spoken: Then I'd go with the roast chicken. I'm not just saying that. It's actually the thing people come back for.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: And if I don't want something that big?
lines.spoken: And if I don't want something that big?

lines.speaker: andre
lines.text: I'd do the soup and the half sandwich. It sounds boring when I say it out loud, but it's good.
lines.spoken: I'd do the soup and the half sandwich. It sounds boring when I say it out loud, but it's good.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Soup and a half sandwich. Okay. I might do that.
lines.spoken: Soup and a half sandwich. Okay. I might do that.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I'm gonna trust you on the chicken. Is it spicy, or...?
lines.spoken: I'm gonna trust you on the chicken. Is it spicy, or...?

lines.speaker: andre
lines.text: It's not spicy. It's just... flavorful, I guess. If you want hot sauce I can bring it.
lines.spoken: It's not spicy. It's just... flavorful, I guess. If you want hot sauce I can bring it.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Can I do the soup without cream? I don't do well with a lot of dairy.
lines.spoken: Can I do the soup without cream? I don't do well with a lot of dairy.

lines.speaker: andre
lines.text: Yeah, the tomato one's fine. I'll put a note. You got it.
lines.spoken: Yeah, the tomato one's fine. I'll put a note. You got it.

lines.speaker: andre
lines.text: Of course. I'll get that in. Chicken, soup and half sandwich, tomato, no cream. Hot sauce on the side.
lines.spoken: Of course. I'll get that in. Chicken, soup and half sandwich, tomato, no cream. Hot sauce on the side.

gist.askEn: Why are they asking the server?

gist.askZh: 最后大概点了什么方向的菜？
gist.askEn: What kind of dishes do they end up leaning toward?
accept: soup and half sandwich for Maya

details.askZh: 烤鸡辣不辣？Chris 还要了什么？
details.askEn: Is the chicken spicy, and what else does Chris want?
What does Maya need changed about the soup?

glue.noteZh: do you 缩成 d'you，和 recommend 连在一起，这是问建议的核心句。

glue.span: What are you in the mood for
glue.hear: What're you in the mood for
glue.noteZh: What are you 缩成 what're you，in the mood for 是固定语块，for 落在句尾很弱。
glue.standard: What are you in the mood for

glue.span: I'd go with the roast chicken
glue.hear: I'd go with the roast chicken
glue.noteZh: I'd go with 表示‘那我建议要这个’，go with the 三个词很快。
glue.standard: I would go with the roast chicken

chunks.sayAfter: Then I'd go with the roast chicken. People come back for it.

roleplay.setupZh: 你在一家不太熟的店里看菜单，想请服务员给个真实建议。先说自己想吃偏重还是偏清淡，再根据建议点，并提一个小要求（比如不要奶油）。
roleplay.aiRole: Andre, a straightforward server who actually has opinions. He asks what you're in the mood for before recommending, and he won't oversell. He will put a note on the ticket if needed.
variants: Chris also needs a dairy-light option.
mustUse: What are you in the mood for
starters: What are you in the mood for?
I'd go with the roast chicken.

fluency.promptZh: 讲讲这次问推荐：服务员先问了什么，给 Chris 和 Maya 各建议了什么，后来又改了哪些细节。准备 15 秒，然后 60、45、30 秒。
fluency.promptEn: Tell the recommendation conversation: what the server asked first, what he suggested for each of them, and what details got changed. Prep 15 seconds, then 60, 45, 30.
